# Imgur

> > Imgur is a community-driven image hosting and sharing platform featuring viral content, user-submitted posts, and real-time content feeds.

Imgur serves as one of the web's largest image hosting platforms, enabling users to upload, share, and discover visual content. The platform emphasizes community engagement through voting, commenting, and content curation that surfaces trending and viral images.

## Key Topics

- image-sharing
- viral-content
- user-submitted
- community-content
- image-gallery
- trending
- popular-posts
- real-time-feed
- new-posts
- image-hosting
- content-curation
- community-voting

## Core Content Feeds

- [Most Viral](https://imgur.com/index.php/index/index): Most viral content gallery featuring trending images and community posts
- [Newest Posts](https://imgur.com/new): User-submitted content feed showing newest posts from Imgur community
